relationships.subject: trans-ethyl p-methoxycinnamate
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistic study showed that it could suppress tyrosine kinase activity of the receptor of VEGF (VEGFR2) and alter its downstream signaling pathways.

relationships.subject: trans-ethyl p-methoxycinnamate
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, it inhibited VEGF-induced sprout formation ex vivo and vessel formation in vivo.

key_findings: TEM is the major anti-angiogenic component of Kaempferia galanga and inhibits VEGF-induced endothelial responses via VEGFR2.
